description: Attaches to up to 32 parameters of any modules and puts out a voltage that follows each one as it moves.

outputs.text: Carries the values of mapping slots 1 to 16 on sixteen polyphonic channels.
Carries the values of mapping slots 17 to 32 on sixteen polyphonic channels.

notes: nothing is sent until a slot is mapped: click a slot in the list, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module; mapping then moves to the next empty slot.
menu: Lock mapping slots — prevents accidental changes to the slot list and stops it capturing mouse scrolling.
Audio rate processing — switched off, the outputs are updated every 32nd sample instead of every sample.
Signal output — sends the parameter values as 0V..10V or as -5V..5V.
Text scrolling — scrolls the name of a mapped parameter across its slot when the name is too long for the display.
Hide mapping indicators — stops the pink square being drawn beside each mapped parameter.
Unmap and Locate and indicate — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu, releasing that slot's parameter, or centring its module on screen and flashing its indicator.
